# Appendix C: Full Evaluation Results {#sec-appendixc .appendix}

This appendix records the complete output behind the summary tables in @sec-chapter5. It lists, for every weight configuration and both observation years, the per-service scores produced by each method, together with the full convergent, discriminant, rank-reversal, weight-space and temporal results. Absolute-mode results are reported alongside the standard formulation as the rank-reversal-safe variant discussed in @sec-rankreversal. In the score tables, $C_i$ is the TOPSIS closeness coefficient, SAW is the Simple Additive Weighting score, and $S$, $R$ and $Q$ are the VIKOR utility, regret and compromise measures. The final column gives each service's rank under TOPSIS, SAW and VIKOR in that order, where rank 1 is the highest debt priority. Rows are ordered by TOPSIS rank.

## Per-Service Scores and Rankings (Absolute Mode)

Under absolute-mode TOPSIS the 2025 equal-weight agreement with SAW and VIKOR is $\tau = 0.867$: the variant places SVC-06 above SVC-04 at ranks 2 and 3, where the standard formulation and both alternative methods place SVC-04 second. This reflects the effect of the fixed reference frame on the closely scored cluster below SVC-01 and accompanies the rank-reversal results in @tbl-appc-rankreversal-abs. In 2024 the variant places SVC-01 first under both configurations, agreeing exactly with VIKOR under equal weights.
